parsed.post: Scaling DEPTH to 8 worked! val_bpb dropped to 0.8925. The model is still responding well to increased depth. Now, I'll attempt to further increase capacity by increasing ASPECT_RATIO back to 64 while keeping DEPTH=8, and I'll also slightly lower the learning rate to ensure stability with the larger architecture.
parsed.description: Increase depth to 8, restore ASPECT_RATIO to 64, and slightly reduce learning rate for stability.
